title: Shuriken
description: Every time you play [blue]3[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks the number of Attacks played each turn. Triggers every 3 Attacks to apply Strength. The relic's counter displays your progress toward the next proc (e.g., 0/3, 1/3, 2/3). Resets at the start of each turn.
